message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Accruals Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of quarterly short-term accruals (change in current assets minus change in current liabilities minus depreciation) over the past 8 quarters.", "rationale": "Firms with more volatile accruals may face greater uncertainty or earnings management, which could be mispriced by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Divide the sum of R&D expense over the past 3 years by the sum of total assets over the same period.", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in R&D relative to assets may be undervalued due to conservative accounting treatment of R&D.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Momentum", "construction": "Indicator variable equal to 1 if the firm initiated a dividend in the past 12 months and 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend initiations may signal management confidence and future profitability not yet reflected in prices.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Trading Volume", "construction": "Aggregate net purchases (buys minus sells) of company shares by insiders over the past 6 months, scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insider buying may indicate undervaluation or positive private information.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Grant Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in the number of patents granted to the firm, using USPTO data.", "rationale": "Rapid growth in patent grants may signal future innovation and competitive advantage.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "Sum of squared revenue shares of the top 5 customers (from 10-K disclosures) in the most recent fiscal year.", "rationale": "Firms with less customer concentration may have more stable revenues and lower risk of negative shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Deferred tax assets divided by total assets, from the most recent annual report.", "rationale": "High deferred tax assets may indicate aggressive accounting or future earnings headwinds.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Payment Stretch", "construction": "Change in accounts payable divided by cost of goods sold over the past year.", "rationale": "Firms stretching payments to suppliers may be facing liquidity issues or managing earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Productivity Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in revenue per employee, using Compustat and company headcount disclosures.", "rationale": "Improving productivity may signal operational efficiency and future profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Shareholder Proposal Rejection Rate", "construction": "Number of shareholder proposals rejected at annual meetings in the past 3 years divided by total proposals submitted.", "rationale": "Frequent rejection of shareholder proposals may indicate entrenched management and potential governance issues.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}]}
